items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had Dick Hyman and Hank Jones on piano. Ossie Johnson and Milt Hinton, you know.

ctx.x: There was a duet, you know. They worked out beautifully. I had some of the best string players out of New York. I had Dick Hyman and Hank Jones on piano. Ossie Johnson and Milt Hinton, you know.
